description: S8 M7 Releases.reconcile_audits and Releases.request_reverification, characterized before the move at application level over a MemoryStore with PLANTED releases (active audit-lifecycle and check-rejected), deployment, research_control, release_queue, deployment_locks and promotion_intents rows, the packaged organization and the harness clock: reconcile_audits with no active release, an inactive or legacy record, a paused, same-release and rolled-back control kept, an invalid active release, incomplete reviews and incomplete checks refused, the activation written with its graph row, idempotence; request_reverification with a missing reason or evidence, a non-conductor, an unknown release, an evaluator-migrated source, the written successor with its event, a replay and a conflicting replay, an existing evaluator or environment successor, and every non-rejected or ineligible source refused via _check_rejected_source; the whole-store digest before and after every call; no Git, Docker, model, provider or PostgreSQL
